core_obligations: Statement (lines 1882-1893): in Situation situation-simplicial-site, for U in C_n and F an abelian sheaf on C_total, H^p(U, F) computed with U viewed as an object of C_total equals H^p(U, g_n^{-1}F).

Viewing explained (proof lines 1895-1900): the phrase 'U viewed as object of C_total' is made precise by the two constructions of C_total - case (A) via Lemma lemma-simplicial-site-site and case (B) via Lemma lemma-simplicial-cocontinuous-site.

Equality (lines 1900-1901): the displayed equality follows from Lemma lemma-restriction-injective-to-component-site together with the definition of cohomology, i.e. the localization C_n -> C does not change the cohomology of the restricted sheaf.
proof_roadmap: Pin down what 'U viewed in C_total' means in cases (A) and (B).
Apply the localization invariance of cohomology.
Conclude the displayed equality for all p.
difficulty_reason: Sanity-check lemma (statement 1882-1893, proof 1895-1901): cohomology of a component computed on the total site equals cohomology of the pulled-back sheaf - the proof resolves the two-case meaning of the statement via the constructions of C_total and invokes the in-source localization lemma plus the definition of cohomology; both steps executed in-span. H3.
